list.text: I caught a whole bunch of Pokémon!
Go, Go, Go!\nMy Bug Pokémon team!

lines: EndSpeech: Tenho todos esses Pokémons e ainda perdi...

list.text: I caught a bunch of Pokémon.\nNow I'm out of Poké Balls.
Sometimes, there are things on the ground even if you can't see them.
That's why I always check where I'm walking.
If you take Bug Pokémon to school, you get to be instantly popular!

lines: EndSpeech: Não serei popular se perder...

list.text: If you have a big Bug Pokémon, people respect you for it.

lines: Se switch garota está on, as ações envolvem o namoradooo!

then.text: \f[face_namo_admiring_boy]\bYou are really good, I'm more impressed by you every time!

else.text: \f[face_namo_admiring_girl]\rYou are really good, I'm more impressed by you every time!

then.text: \f[face_namo_boy]\bOh, it was close! I could have caught it for you if you asked...

else.text: \f[face_namo_girl]\rOh, it was close! I could have caught it for you if you asked...

then.text: \f[face_namo_boy]\bHahahaha! You ran away, but it was just a little Wurmple!
\f[face_namo_love_boy]\bYou don't need to be scared when you are with me, I'll protect you...

else.text: \f[face_namo_girl]\rHahahaha! You ran away, but it was just a little Wurmple!

then.text: \f[face_namo_angry_boy]\bIt was just a little Wurmple...\nI could have caught it if you asked me...

else.text: \f[face_namo_angry_girl]\rIt was just a little Wurmple...\nI could have caught it if you asked me...

list.text: If your Pokémon are weak and you want to avoid battles, you should stay out of tall grass.
